mapper.select: SELECT DV.DIVISION_CODE , CASE #{default_language} WHEN 'KOR' THEN DIVISION_NAME WHEN 'ENG' THEN DIVISION_NAME_ENG END AS DIVISION_NAME FROM DIVISION DV WHERE DV.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND DV.STATUS = 'Y' AND DV.DIVISION_GROUP_CODE = '00' AND (DV.DIVISION_TYPE = 'A' OR DV.DIVISION_TYPE = 'P') ORDER BY DIVISION_CODE
